{"code":"`timescale 1ns/1ps\n\n// csr_regblock_tb — self-checking testbench for the memory-mapped\n// control/status register block.\n//\n// Timing contract under test: rdata, ready and irq are COMBINATIONAL, so a\n// transaction driven in one settled region is sampled at the next posedge and\n// its result is readable in the settled region that follows, while the same\n// stimulus is still applied. The reference model mirrors that exactly: its\n// state updates on the posedge, its outputs are combinational functions of\n// the current inputs and that state. Every check compares a DUT port signal\n// to its reference counterpart, both read live.\nmodule csr_regblock_tb;\n\n  localparam int ADDR_W = 4;\n\n  localparam logic [ADDR_W-1:0] ADDR_CTRL        = ADDR_W'(0);\n  localparam logic [ADDR_W-1:0] ADDR_STATUS      = ADDR_W'(1);\n  localparam logic [ADDR_W-1:0] ADDR_EVENT_CLEAR = ADDR_W'(2);\n  localparam logic [ADDR_W-1:0] ADDR_VERSION     = ADDR_W'(3);\n  localparam logic [31:0]       VERSION_VALUE    = 32'h0000_0001;\n\n  // ── Clock ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  logic clk;\n  initial clk = 1'b0;\n  always #5 clk = ~clk;\n\n  // ── DUT interface ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  logic              rst_n;\n  logic              sel;\n  logic              write;\n  logic [ADDR_W-1:0] addr;\n  logic [31:0]       wdata;\n  logic              event_in;\n  logic [31:0]       rdata;\n  logic              ready;\n  logic              irq;\n\n  csr_regblock #(.ADDR_W(ADDR_W)) dut (\n    .clk      (clk),\n    .rst_n    (rst_n),\n    .sel      (sel),\n    .write    (write),\n    .addr     (addr),\n    .wdata    (wdata),\n    .event_in (event_in),\n    .rdata    (rdata),\n    .ready    (ready),\n    .irq      (irq)\n  );\n\n  // ── Reference model ────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  // State: the two elements the spec says exist. Updated on the same edge\n  // the DUT uses, with event_in resolved ahead of the write-1-to-clear.\n  logic [31:0] ref_ctrl;\n  logic        ref_flag;\n\n  always_ff @(posedge clk) begin\n    if (!rst_n) begin\n      ref_ctrl <= 32'h0000_0000;\n      ref_flag <= 1'b0;\n    end else begin\n      if (sel && write && (addr == ADDR_CTRL)) ref_ctrl <= wdata;\n      if (event_in)                                            ref_flag <= 1'b1;\n      else if (sel && write && (addr == ADDR_EVENT_CLEAR) && wdata[0]) ref_flag <= 1'b0;\n    end\n  end\n\n  // Outputs: combinational from the current stimulus and reference state,\n  // matching the DUT's same-cycle read/ready/irq contract.\n  logic [31:0] ref_rdata;\n  logic        ref_ready;\n  logic        ref_irq;\n\n  always_comb begin\n    ref_rdata = 32'h0000_0000;\n    if (sel && !write) begin\n      case (addr)\n        ADDR_CTRL:        ref_rdata = ref_ctrl;\n        ADDR_STATUS:      ref_rdata = {31'h0, ref_flag};\n        ADDR_EVENT_CLEAR: ref_rdata = 32'h0000_0000;\n        ADDR_VERSION:     ref_rdata = VERSION_VALUE;\n        default:          ref_rdata = 32'h0000_0000;\n      endcase\n    end\n  end\n\n  assign ref_ready = sel;\n  assign ref_irq   = ref_flag & ref_ctrl[0];\n\n  // ── Bookkeeping ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  int passes;\n  int fails;\n  int cyc;\n  initial begin\n    passes = 0;\n    fails  = 0;\n    cyc    = 0;\n  end\n  always @(posedge clk) cyc <= cyc + 1;\n\n  task automatic check(input logic cond, input string label);\n    if (cond === 1'b1) begin\n      passes++;\n      $display(\"[PASS] %s @%0d cycles\", label, cyc);\n    end else begin\n      fails++;\n      $display(\"[FAIL] %s @%0d cycles\", label, cyc);\n    end\n  endtask\n\n  // Value comparison: the [PASS]/[FAIL] marker still comes only from\n  // check(); the mismatch detail is a plain, marker-free line.\n  task automatic check_val(input logic [31:0] got, input logic [31:0] exp,\n                           input string label);\n    if (got !== exp) $display(\"   mismatch %s: expected %08h actual %08h\", label, exp, got);\n    check(got === exp, label);\n  endtask\n\n  task automatic step(input int n = 1);\n    repeat (n) begin\n      @(posedge clk);\n      #1;   // settle: DUT and reference have both updated\n    end\n  endtask\n\n  task automatic idle();\n    sel      = 1'b0;\n    write    = 1'b0;\n    addr     = '0;\n    wdata    = '0;\n    event_in = 1'b0;\n  endtask\n\n  task automatic apply_reset();\n    rst_n = 1'b0;\n    idle();\n    step(3);\n    rst_n = 1'b1;\n    step(1);\n  endtask\n\n  // One write transaction: stimulus applied in the settled region, sampled\n  // at the next edge, then the bus is returned to idle.\n  task automatic bus_write(input logic [ADDR_W-1:0] a, input logic [31:0] d);\n    sel   = 1'b1;\n    write = 1'b1;\n    addr  = a;\n    wdata = d;\n    step(1);\n    idle();\n  endtask\n\n  // ── REQ-INTF-001 ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  task automatic test_req_intf_001();\n    // covers: REQ-INTF-001\n    apply_reset();\n    check_val(rdata, ref_rdata, \"REQ-INTF-001.1\");\n    check(ready === ref_ready, \"REQ-INTF-001.2\");\n    check(irq === ref_irq,     \"REQ-INTF-001.3\");\n    check(rdata === 32'h0000_0000, \"REQ-INTF-001.4\");\n    check(ready === 1'b0, \"REQ-INTF-001.5\");\n    check(irq === 1'b0,   \"REQ-INTF-001.6\");\n    // every port drives a transaction end to end\n    sel = 1'b1; write = 1'b0; addr = ADDR_VERSION;\n    step(1);\n    check_val(rdata, ref_rdata, \"REQ-INTF-001.7\");\n    check(ready === ref_ready, \"REQ-INTF-001.8\");\n    idle();\n    step(1);\n  endtask\n\n  // ── REQ-INTF-002 ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  task automatic test_req_intf_002();\n    // covers: REQ-INTF-002\n    apply_reset();\n    check(ready === 1'b0, \"REQ-INTF-002.1\");\n    sel = 1'b1; write = 1'b0; addr = ADDR_CTRL;\n    step(1);\n    check(ready === 1'b1,      \"REQ-INTF-002.2\");\n    check(ready === ref_ready, \"REQ-INTF-002.3\");\n    idle();\n    step(1);\n    check(ready === 1'b0,      \"REQ-INTF-002.4\");\n    check(ready === ref_ready, \"REQ-INTF-002.5\");\n    // two consecutive transactions: ready high on both\n    sel = 1'b1; write = 1'b0; addr = ADDR_VERSION;\n    step(1);\n    check(ready === 1'b1, \"REQ-INTF-002.6\");\n    addr = ADDR_STATUS;\n    step(1);\n    check(ready === 1'b1, \"REQ-INTF-002.7\");\n    idle();\n    step(1);\n    check(ready === 1'b0, \"REQ-INTF-002.8\");\n  endtask\n\n  // ── REQ-INTF-003 ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  task automatic test_req_intf_003();\n    // covers: REQ-INTF-003\n    apply_reset();\n    bus_write(ADDR_CTRL, 32'hDEAD_BEEF);\n    step(1);\n    check_val(rdata, 32'h0000_0000, \"REQ-INTF-003.1\");\n    check_val(rdata, ref_rdata,     \"REQ-INTF-003.2\");\n    // a read, then idle again\n    sel = 1'b1; write = 1'b0; addr = ADDR_CTRL;\n    step(1);\n    check_val(rdata, 32'hDEAD_BEEF, \"REQ-INTF-003.3\");\n    idle();\n    step(1);\n    check_val(rdata, 32'h0000_0000, \"REQ-INTF-003.4\");\n    check_val(rdata, ref_rdata,     \"REQ-INTF-003.5\");\n  endtask\n\n  // ── REQ-FUNC-001 ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  task automatic test_req_func_001();\n    // covers: REQ-FUNC-001\n    apply_reset();\n    bus_write(ADDR_CTRL, 32'hA5A5_5A5A);\n    sel = 1'b1; write = 1'b0; addr = ADDR_CTRL;\n    step(1);\n    check_val(rdata, 32'hA5A5_5A5A, \"REQ-FUNC-001.1\");\n    check_val(rdata, ref_rdata,     \"REQ-FUNC-001.2\");\n    idle();\n    step(1);\n    // boundary: all ones, then all zeros\n    bus_write(ADDR_CTRL, 32'hFFFF_FFFF);\n    sel = 1'b1; write = 1'b0; addr = ADDR_CTRL;\n    step(1);\n    check_val(rdata, 32'hFFFF_FFFF, \"REQ-FUNC-001.3\");\n    check_val(rdata, ref_rdata,     \"REQ-FUNC-001.4\");\n    idle();\n    step(1);\n    bus_write(ADDR_CTRL, 32'h0000_0000);\n    sel = 1'b1; write = 1'b0; addr = ADDR_CTRL;\n    step(1);\n    check_val(rdata, 32'h0000_0000, \"REQ-FUNC-001.5\");\n    check_val(rdata, ref_rdata,     \"REQ-FUNC-001.6\");\n    idle();\n    step(1);\n    // a random value, width-cast at generation\n    begin\n      logic [31:0] rnd;\n      rnd = 32'($urandom_range(0, 32'hFFFF_FFFF));\n      bus_write(ADDR_CTRL, rnd);\n      sel = 1'b1; write = 1'b0; addr = ADDR_CTRL;\n      step(1);\n      check_val(rdata, rnd,       \"REQ-FUNC-001.7\");\n      check_val(rdata, ref_rdata, \"REQ-FUNC-001.8\");\n      idle();\n      step(1);\n    end\n  endtask\n\n  // ── REQ-FUNC-002 ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  task automatic test_req_func_002();\n    // covers: REQ-FUNC-002\n    apply_reset();\n    // read of CTRL after reset returns the reset value\n    sel = 1'b1; write = 1'b0; addr = ADDR_CTRL;\n    step(1);\n    check_val(rdata, 32'h0000_0000, \"REQ-FUNC-002.1\");\n    check_val(rdata, ref_rdata,     \"REQ-FUNC-002.2\");\n    idle();\n    step(1);\n    bus_write(ADDR_CTRL, 32'h1234_5678);\n    sel = 1'b1; write = 1'b0; addr = ADDR_CTRL;\n    step(1);\n    check_val(rdata, 32'h1234_5678, \"REQ-FUNC-002.3\");\n    check_val(rdata, ref_rdata,     \"REQ-FUNC-002.4\");\n    // the value is still there on a second, back-to-back read\n    step(1);\n    check_val(rdata, ref_rdata, \"REQ-FUNC-002.5\");\n    idle();\n    step(1);\n  endtask\n\n  // ── REQ-FUNC-003 ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  task automatic test_req_func_003();\n    // covers: REQ-FUNC-003\n    apply_reset();\n    // flag clear after reset\n    sel = 1'b1; write = 1'b0; addr = ADDR_STATUS;\n    step(1);\n    check_val(rdata, 32'h0000_0000, \"REQ-FUNC-003.1\");\n    check_val(rdata, ref_rdata,     \"REQ-FUNC-003.2\");\n    idle();\n    step(1);\n    // set the flag, then read STATUS\n    event_in = 1'b1;\n    step(1);\n    event_in = 1'b0;\n    sel = 1'b1; write = 1'b0; addr = ADDR_STATUS;\n    step(1);\n    check_val(rdata, 32'h0000_0001, \"REQ-FUNC-003.3\");\n    check_val(rdata, ref_rdata,     \"REQ-FUNC-003.4\");\n    check(rdata[31:1] === 31'h0,    \"REQ-FUNC-003.5\");\n    idle();\n    step(1);\n  endtask\n\n  // ── REQ-FUNC-004 ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  task automatic test_req_func_004();\n    // covers: REQ-FUNC-004\n    apply_reset();\n    event_in = 1'b1;\n    step(1);\n    event_in = 1'b0;\n    // a read of EVENT_CLEAR returns zero\n    sel = 1'b1; write = 1'b0; addr = ADDR_EVENT_CLEAR;\n    step(1);\n    check_val(rdata, 32'h0000_0000, \"REQ-FUNC-004.1\");\n    check_val(rdata, ref_rdata,     \"REQ-FUNC-004.2\");\n    idle();\n    step(1);\n    // and it did not disturb the sticky flag\n    sel = 1'b1; write = 1'b0; addr = ADDR_STATUS;\n    step(1);\n    check_val(rdata, 32'h0000_0001, \"REQ-FUNC-004.3\");\n    check_val(rdata, ref_rdata,     \"REQ-FUNC-004.4\");\n    idle();\n    step(1);\n  endtask\n\n  // ── REQ-FUNC-005 ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  task automatic test_req_func_005();\n    // covers: REQ-FUNC-005\n    apply_reset();\n    sel = 1'b1; write = 1'b0; addr = ADDR_VERSION;\n    step(1);\n    check_val(rdata, VERSION_VALUE, \"REQ-FUNC-005.1\");\n    check_val(rdata, ref_rdata,     \"REQ-FUNC-005.2\");\n    idle();\n    step(1);\n    // read-only: a write must not change it\n    bus_write(ADDR_VERSION, 32'hFFFF_FFFF);\n    sel = 1'b1; write = 1'b0; addr = ADDR_VERSION;\n    step(1);\n    check_val(rdata, VERSION_VALUE, \"REQ-FUNC-005.3\");\n    check_val(rdata, ref_rdata,     \"REQ-FUNC-005.4\");\n    idle();\n    step(1);\n  endtask\n\n  // ── REQ-FUNC-006 ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  task automatic test_req_func_006();\n    // covers: REQ-FUNC-006\n    apply_reset();\n    event_in = 1'b1;\n    step(1);\n    event_in = 1'b0;\n    step(1);\n    // writing 0 to bit 0 leaves the flag set\n    bus_write(ADDR_EVENT_CLEAR, 32'h0000_0000);\n    sel = 1'b1; write = 1'b0; addr = ADDR_STATUS;\n    step(1);\n    check_val(rdata, 32'h0000_0001, \"REQ-FUNC-006.1\");\n    check_val(rdata, ref_rdata,     \"REQ-FUNC-006.2\");\n    idle();\n    step(1);\n    // writing 1 to bit 0 clears it\n    bus_write(ADDR_EVENT_CLEAR, 32'h0000_0001);\n    sel = 1'b1; write = 1'b0; addr = ADDR_STATUS;\n    step(1);\n    check_val(rdata, 32'h0000_0000, \"REQ-FUNC-006.3\");\n    check_val(rdata, ref_rdata,     \"REQ-FUNC-006.4\");\n    idle();\n    step(1);\n    // upper bits of wdata are irrelevant: only bit 0 clears\n    event_in = 1'b1;\n    step(1);\n    event_in = 1'b0;\n    step(1);\n    bus_write(ADDR_EVENT_CLEAR, 32'hFFFF_FFFE);\n    sel = 1'b1; write = 1'b0; addr = ADDR_STATUS;\n    step(1);\n    check_val(rdata, 32'h0000_0001, \"REQ-FUNC-006.5\");\n    check_val(rdata, ref_rdata,     \"REQ-FUNC-006.6\");\n    idle();\n    step(1);\n  endtask\n\n  // ── REQ-FUNC-007 ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  task automatic test_req_func_007();\n    // covers: REQ-FUNC-007\n    apply_reset();\n    // event_in alone sets the flag\n    event_in = 1'b1;\n    step(1);\n    event_in = 1'b0;\n    sel = 1'b1; write = 1'b0; addr = ADDR_STATUS;\n    step(1);\n    check_val(rdata, 32'h0000_0001, \"REQ-FUNC-007.1\");\n    check_val(rdata, ref_rdata,     \"REQ-FUNC-007.2\");\n    idle();\n    step(1);\n    // the race: event_in and a write-1-to-clear in the SAME cycle\n    sel      = 1'b1;\n    write    = 1'b1;\n    addr     = ADDR_EVENT_CLEAR;\n    wdata    = 32'h0000_0001;\n    event_in = 1'b1;\n    step(1);\n    idle();\n    sel = 1'b1; write = 1'b0; addr = ADDR_STATUS;\n    step(1);\n    check_val(rdata, 32'h0000_0001, \"REQ-FUNC-007.3\");\n    check_val(rdata, ref_rdata,     \"REQ-FUNC-007.4\");\n    idle();\n    step(1);\n    // the same race starting from a cleared flag\n    bus_write(ADDR_EVENT_CLEAR, 32'h0000_0001);\n    step(1);\n    sel      = 1'b1;\n    write    = 1'b1;\n    addr     = ADDR_EVENT_CLEAR;\n    wdata    = 32'h0000_0001;\n    event_in = 1'b1;\n    step(1);\n    idle();\n    sel = 1'b1; write = 1'b0; addr = ADDR_STATUS;\n    step(1);\n    check_val(rdata, 32'h0000_0001, \"REQ-FUNC-007.5\");\n    check_val(rdata, ref_rdata,     \"REQ-FUNC-007.6\");\n    idle();\n    step(1);\n  endtask\n\n  // ── REQ-FUNC-008 ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  task automatic test_req_func_008();\n    // covers: REQ-FUNC-008\n    apply_reset();\n    bus_write(ADDR_CTRL, 32'hCAFE_0001);\n    // a write to STATUS must not change the flag or CTRL\n    event_in = 1'b0;\n    bus_write(ADDR_STATUS, 32'hFFFF_FFFF);\n    sel = 1'b1; write = 1'b0; addr = ADDR_STATUS;\n    step(1);\n    check_val(rdata, 32'h0000_0000, \"REQ-FUNC-008.1\");\n    check_val(rdata, ref_rdata,     \"REQ-FUNC-008.2\");\n    idle();\n    step(1);\n    sel = 1'b1; write = 1'b0; addr = ADDR_CTRL;\n    step(1);\n    check_val(rdata, 32'hCAFE_0001, \"REQ-FUNC-008.3\");\n    check_val(rdata, ref_rdata,     \"REQ-FUNC-008.4\");\n    idle();\n    step(1);\n    // a write to an unmapped address changes nothing\n    bus_write(ADDR_W'(7), 32'hFFFF_FFFF);\n    sel = 1'b1; write = 1'b0; addr = ADDR_CTRL;\n    step(1);\n    check_val(rdata, 32'hCAFE_0001, \"REQ-FUNC-008.5\");\n    check_val(rdata, ref_rdata,     \"REQ-FUNC-008.6\");\n    idle();\n    step(1);\n    // a write to VERSION changes nothing\n    bus_write(ADDR_VERSION, 32'h0000_0000);\n    sel = 1'b1; write = 1'b0; addr = ADDR_CTRL;\n    step(1);\n    check_val(rdata, 32'hCAFE_0001, \"REQ-FUNC-008.7\");\n    check_val(rdata, ref_rdata,     \"REQ-FUNC-008.8\");\n    idle();\n    step(1);\n  endtask\n\n  // ── REQ-TIME-001 ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  task automatic test_req_time_001();\n    // covers: REQ-TIME-001\n    apply_reset();\n    check(irq === 1'b0,     \"REQ-TIME-001.1\");\n    check(irq === ref_irq,  \"REQ-TIME-001.2\");\n    // flag set, enable clear → no interrupt\n    event_in = 1'b1;\n    step(1);\n    event_in = 1'b0;\n    check(irq === 1'b0,    \"REQ-TIME-001.3\");\n    check(irq === ref_irq, \"REQ-TIME-001.4\");\n    // enable set while the flag is already set → interrupt in the same\n    // cycle the enable lands, with no extra cycle of delay\n    bus_write(ADDR_CTRL, 32'h0000_0001);\n    check(irq === 1'b1,    \"REQ-TIME-001.5\");\n    check(irq === ref_irq, \"REQ-TIME-001.6\");\n    step(1);\n    check(irq === 1'b1,    \"REQ-TIME-001.7\");\n    // clearing the flag drops the interrupt in that same cycle\n    bus_write(ADDR_EVENT_CLEAR, 32'h0000_0001);\n    check(irq === 1'b0,    \"REQ-TIME-001.8\");\n    check(irq === ref_irq, \"REQ-TIME-001.9\");\n    // enable alone, flag clear → still no interrupt\n    step(1);\n    check(irq === 1'b0,    \"REQ-TIME-001.10\");\n    // a new event with the enable still set raises it again immediately\n    event_in = 1'b1;\n    step(1);\n    event_in = 1'b0;\n    check(irq === 1'b1,    \"REQ-TIME-001.11\");\n    check(irq === ref_irq, \"REQ-TIME-001.12\");\n    step(1);\n  endtask\n\n  // ── REQ-TIME-002 ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  task automatic test_req_time_002();\n    // covers: REQ-TIME-002\n    apply_reset();\n    // dirty both state elements\n    bus_write(ADDR_CTRL, 32'hFFFF_FFFF);\n    event_in = 1'b1;\n    step(1);\n    event_in = 1'b0;\n    step(1);\n    check(irq === 1'b1, \"REQ-TIME-002.1\");\n    // synchronous reset clears both\n    rst_n = 1'b0;\n    step(1);\n    rst_n = 1'b1;\n    check(irq === 1'b0,    \"REQ-TIME-002.2\");\n    check(irq === ref_irq, \"REQ-TIME-002.3\");\n    sel = 1'b1; write = 1'b0; addr = ADDR_CTRL;\n    step(1);\n    check_val(rdata, 32'h0000_0000, \"REQ-TIME-002.4\");\n    check_val(rdata, ref_rdata,     \"REQ-TIME-002.5\");\n    idle();\n    step(1);\n    sel = 1'b1; write = 1'b0; addr = ADDR_STATUS;\n    step(1);\n    check_val(rdata, 32'h0000_0000, \"REQ-TIME-002.6\");\n    check_val(rdata, ref_rdata,     \"REQ-TIME-002.7\");\n    idle();\n    step(1);\n    // reads still work after reset release\n    bus_write(ADDR_CTRL, 32'h0000_00FF);\n    sel = 1'b1; write = 1'b0; addr = ADDR_CTRL;\n    step(1);\n    check_val(rdata, 32'h0000_00FF, \"REQ-TIME-002.8\");\n    idle();\n    step(1);\n  endtask\n\n  // ── REQ-TIME-003 ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  task automatic test_req_time_003();\n    // covers: REQ-TIME-003\n    apply_reset();\n    bus_write(ADDR_CTRL, 32'h0000_00A5);\n    // sel stays high across four consecutive cycles, address changing each\n    // cycle: every one is a complete transaction with no wait states\n    sel = 1'b1; write = 1'b0; addr = ADDR_CTRL;\n    step(1);\n    check_val(rdata, ref_rdata, \"REQ-TIME-003.1\");\n    check(ready === 1'b1,       \"REQ-TIME-003.2\");\n    addr = ADDR_STATUS;\n    step(1);\n    check_val(rdata, ref_rdata, \"REQ-TIME-003.3\");\n    check(ready === 1'b1,       \"REQ-TIME-003.4\");\n    addr = ADDR_VERSION;\n    step(1);\n    check_val(rdata, VERSION_VALUE, \"REQ-TIME-003.5\");\n    check_val(rdata, ref_rdata,     \"REQ-TIME-003.6\");\n    check(ready === 1'b1,           \"REQ-TIME-003.7\");\n    addr = ADDR_CTRL;\n    step(1);\n    check_val(rdata, 32'h0000_00A5, \"REQ-TIME-003.8\");\n    check(ready === 1'b1,           \"REQ-TIME-003.9\");\n    idle();\n    step(1);\n    check(ready === 1'b0, \"REQ-TIME-003.10\");\n    // back-to-back writes on consecutive cycles\n    sel = 1'b1; write = 1'b1; addr = ADDR_CTRL; wdata = 32'h1111_1111;\n    step(1);\n    wdata = 32'h2222_2222;\n    step(1);\n    idle();\n    sel = 1'b1; write = 1'b0; addr = ADDR_CTRL;\n    step(1);\n    check_val(rdata, 32'h2222_2222, \"REQ-TIME-003.11\");\n    check_val(rdata, ref_rdata,     \"REQ-TIME-003.12\");\n    idle();\n    step(1);\n  endtask\n\n  // ── REQ-ERR-001 ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  task automatic test_req_err_001();\n    // covers: REQ-ERR-001\n    apply_reset();\n    bus_write(ADDR_CTRL, 32'hFFFF_FFFF);\n    for (int a = 4; a < 16; a++) begin\n      sel = 1'b1; write = 1'b0; addr = ADDR_W'(a);\n      step(1);\n
